words.example: Please stamp and sign the form.
They will not accept the original without a wet signature.
words.exampleZh: 原件上没有手写签名，他们不会收。

words.example: For internal leave forms, an e-signature is all we need.
words.exampleZh: 内部请假表有电子签名就够了。

words.example: Write your initials in the margin beside each change you make.
words.exampleZh: 请在你修改的每一处页边签上姓名缩写。

words.example: As each form arrives, reception adds the date stamp.
words.exampleZh: 每份表格一到，接待处就盖上日期章。

words.meaning: 安全文件传输（SSH File Transfer Protocol）
words.example: SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol) is how the reference lab drops results each hour.
words.exampleZh: 合作检验所每小时用 SFTP（安全文件传输）投递一次结果。

words.meaning: 文件共享协议（Server Message Block）
words.example: SMB (Server Message Block) signing is required before the file server returns to the ward.
words.exampleZh: 文件服务器重新给病区用之前，必须打开 SMB（文件共享协议）签名。

words.meaning: 网络文件系统（Network File System）
words.example: NFS (Network File System) exports on the imaging archive are mounted read-only by the viewers.
words.exampleZh: 影像归档上的 NFS（网络文件系统）导出，阅片端是只读挂载的。

words.meaning: 通用互联网文件系统（Common Internet File System）
words.example: CIFS (Common Internet File System) shares from the old file server still feed two lab instruments.
words.exampleZh: 旧文件服务器上的 CIFS（通用互联网文件系统）共享还在给两台检验仪器送数据。

words.meaning: 远程桌面协议（Remote Desktop Protocol）
words.example: RDP (Remote Desktop Protocol) to the jump host is the only path into the server VLAN.
words.exampleZh: 进服务器 VLAN 只能走跳板机上的 RDP（远程桌面协议）。
